title: PLURAL: A Global Dataset for Value Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to open-ended dilemmas using the LLM-GLOBE benchmark to measure alignment with nine cultural dimensions, alongside blind human evaluations judging how well responses reflect values typical of specific cultures.
Measuring the mean absolute error between a model's generated responses and specific countries' ground-truth GLOBE scores, and predicting respondent countries based on their value embeddings.
